dex.entry: The luminous anchor of the Solar Constellation, a great heron-phoenix whose plumage is the last fragment of stored daylight in the Sunken Solarium. It doesn't burn — it glows with the warm memory of sunlight, a diffuse gold that makes everything it stands beside look briefly like afternoon. Lucan Py

art.silhouette: Tall, elegant heron-phoenix with long sweeping tail feathers that trail behind like a train. Plumage in warm gold and honey-amber, edged with faint diamond-cyan light. The chest and neck are pale as bone-white parchment. One wing is slightly shorter — an old wound that never quite healed. Eyes are deep amber, warm and patient. The silhouette is all grace and faded glory.

art.direction: The sorrowful beauty of something magnificent that has endured too long alone. Players who battle this one in the Solarium will feel the whole Vesperholm mood in one encounter.
